module: Third-party library SLAXML v0.8 (Gavin Kistner, MIT license): pure-Lua SAX-type XML parser with namespace handling. You pass it callbacks (pi, comment, startElement, attribute, text, closeElement); it calls them while reading. The game uses it to read XML (e.g. xlsxlib, JUnit writing).
notes: Without custom callbacks, `SLAXML:parser()` uses default callbacks that print (print/io.write) each event.
`parse` raises an error if no element is found ("Parsing did not discover any elements"), if elements remain open, if a namespace prefix is unknown, or if the content of a tag cannot be read.
Option `options.stripWhitespace`: removes leading/trailing whitespace from the text (default false).
`SLAXML:dom` is defined here (simple version) and redefined by libs/slaxml/slaxdom (which adds nsPrefix and the `xml` serialization): loading slaxdom replaces this version.

parser.desc: Creates a parser object {_call, parse} using the given callbacks (or the default ones that print).

callbacks.desc: Callback table: pi(target, content), comment(content), startElement(name, nsURI, nsPrefix), attribute(name, value, nsURI, nsPrefix), text(text, cdata), closeElement(name, nsURI, nsPrefix).

parse.desc: Parses the XML text by calling the parser's callbacks (or SLAXML's if called directly). Handles the standard entities (< > & " ') and numeric references.

dom.desc: Parses the XML and returns a flat DOM: document {type='document', name='#doc', kids, root}, elements {type='element', name, kids, el, attr, nsURI, parent}, attributes, texts, comments, processing instructions. With opts.simple, the parent links and `el` are not created. Raises an error if there are several roots or an unexpected closing tag.
